Works anywhere

tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.water:
Transfers hydro power into 2u OGE per second
Works in water
tooltip.origolds_ia.bs.water: "Don't stare at me like that, I'm not Moana..."
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.fire:

Works if fuel provided
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.magic:
Transfers Origold Mana into 50u OGE per second
Works if Magigold Core or other Mana-rich objects provided
tooltip.origolds_ia.bs.magic: "Magic is what's at the end of science :D"
tooltip.origolds_ia.bs.capacitor: "Surprised by how much it can eat"
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.core: Essential material for crafting all resource generators
tooltip.origolds_ia.bs.core: "This is what we call sustainable development"
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.shiny_chunk: Sifting with the Origold Sifter can yield many good things
tooltip.origolds_ia.bs.shiny_chunk: "It looks pretty. If I don't get a diamond out of it, I'm totally getting scammed"
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.shiny_shard: Sifting with the Origold Sifter can yield some good things
tooltip.origolds_ia.bs.shiny_shard: "If I don't sift it, it looks like it could make a pretty good little knife"
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.shiny_crumb: Sifting with the Origold Sifter can yield a few good things
tooltip.origolds_ia.bs.shiny_crumb: "You're telling me a tiny speck like this could hide a diamond?!"
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.concentrated: Refined %s. Can be smelted normally, but cannot be used as a crafting material
tooltip.origolds_ia.bs.concentrated: "The presence of it already doubled your raw ore outcome. You're not expecting more, aren't you?"
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.gravel: Consumes 5u OGE to spawn a gravel on top per second
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.clay: Consumes 10u OGE to spawn a block of clay on top per second
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.obsidian: Consumes 50u OGE to spawn an obsidian on top per second
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.pulverizer:
Consumes 5u OGE to crush raw ore into 2 concentrated raw ores, or crush ore blocks to yield double the amount of outcomes compared to standard mining
Also allows crushing obsidian to obtain some shiny goodies
tooltip.origolds_ia.bs.pulverizer:
"Half the workload and double the outcome
Nice!"
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.sifter:
Consumes 5u of OGE to sift through gravel or clay and obtain some shiny goodies
Can also sift these shiny items further to reveal exactly what they are
tooltip.origolds_ia.bs.sifter: "This makes you rich! Though a bit water and energy hungry. Not exactly eco-friendly"
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.drawer:
Stores up to 729 stacks of a single item type
Hold an item and press Alt+middle mouse button to bind that item; afterwards only it can enter
Press Alt+middle with an empty hand to clear the binding
tooltip.origolds_ia.bs.drawer: "It's very devoted, only loves its first sight"
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.voiding_stati:
Detects items in the block above and destroys them when it deems them useless
Hold Alt and click left/right mouse button to switch the interval for judging items as trash
tooltip.origolds_ia.ctrl.voiding_station:
When the quantity of a certain item among the dropped items above or inside the container above has not decreased for a continuous period of time (by any means of decrease, including but not limited to being sucked away by hoppers or logistics pipes, being taken out manually by a player, etc.), all dropped items in this block or all items with the same name and ID in the container above will be judged as trash and destroyed entirely.
Very suitable for handling unwanted materials from various farms or mob grinders, such as ender pearls from an Enderman farm, rotten flesh/gold swords from a Zombified Piglin farm, poisonous potatoes from an automatic farm, etc.
tooltip.origolds_ia.bs.voiding_station: "The smartest trash can, it will show you what 'out of sight, out of mind' means"
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.gravity_casse:
Sucks in dropped items within its range
Hold Alt and click left/right mouse button to switch range size
Hold an item and press Alt+middle mouse button to bind that item; afterwards only it can enter
Press Alt+middle with an empty hand to clear the binding
tooltip.origolds_ia.bs.gravity_cassette: "If the Origold Energia Capacitor is a passive big eater, then this is an active one"
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.blower:
Consumes 1u OGE per second to generate a 9-block-long wind field
The wind field pushes entities at 9m/s
Hold Ctrl and click left/right mouse button to adjust wind field length at higher OGE cost
Hold Ctrl+Alt and click left/right mouse button to adjust wind field push speed at higher OGE cost
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.mech_enchante:
Allows anvil-like enchanting by consuming OGE and time
Can consume large amounts of OGE for over-limit fusion, max level is 2x original
Some enchantments cannot be over-limit fused because they either bug out or have no effect at higher levels
Also allows advanced disenchanting: transfer enchantments from an item to a book, or move the first enchantment from a multi-enchantment book to a blank book
Hold Ctrl and click left/right mouse button to switch enchant speed tiers at higher OGE cost
tooltip.origolds_ia.ctrl.mech_enchanter:
For max level 5:
5-6 consumes 1050u, takes 168 seconds; 6-7 consumes 2100u, takes 336 seconds; 7-8 consumes 3150u, takes 504 seconds; 8-9 consumes 4200u, takes 672 seconds; 9-10 consumes 5400u, takes 864 seconds. Total consumption 60000u, total time 9600 seconds (160 minutes).
For max level 4:
4-5 consumes 2015u, takes 322 seconds; 5-6 consumes 4030u, takes 645 seconds; 6-7 consumes 6045u, takes 968 seconds; 7-8 consumes 8170u, takes 1308 seconds. Total consumption 52500u, total time 8400 seconds (140 minutes).
For max level 3:
3-4 consumes 4075u, takes 652 seconds; 4-5 consumes 8150u, takes 1304 seconds; 5-6 consumes 12400u, takes 1984 seconds. Total consumption 45000u, total time 7200 seconds (120 minutes).
For max level 2:
2-3 consumes 9375u, takes 1500 seconds; 3-4 consumes 18750u, takes 3000 seconds. Total consumption 37500u, total time 6000 seconds (100 minutes).
For max level 1: 1-2 consumes 30000u, takes 4800 seconds. Total consumption 30000u, total time 4800 seconds (80 minutes).

The following enchantments cannot be merged: Mending, Infinity, Quick Charge, Lure, Soul Speed, Swift Sneak, Wind Burst, Flame, Silk Touch, Depth Strider, Channeling, Curse of Binding / Curse of Vanishing. This is because they either have bugs at higher levels or have no effect at higher levels (Placeholder enchantment?!).

The auto enchanter can also be used to transfer enchantments. Place the item to be disenchanted in the first slot, and a blank book in the second slot. It will consume 600 base OGE and take 16 seconds (if no over-limit enchantments are involved) / 160 seconds (if involved) base time to transfer all enchantments from the item in the first slot to the book in the second slot. The output slot will contain the enchanted book. This process does not destroy the item in the first slot. Place a multi-enchantment book in the first slot and a blank book in the second slot. It will consume 300 base OGE to transfer the first enchantment from the enchanted book to the blank book. If the transferred enchantment is not an over-limit enchantment, it takes 8 seconds base time; otherwise, it takes 80 seconds.

The 4x tier doubles OGE consumption but reduces time to one quarter; the 16x tier quadruples OGE consumption but reduces time to one sixteenth.
tooltip.origolds_ia.bs.mech_enchanter:
"This is much better than the electric enchanter from Slimefun next door
It can produce and sell by itself!"
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.kela:
Consumes OGE and bone meal to apply very strong fertilizer to fertilizable items within its range
Can also make barren dirt grow grass again
Hold Ctrl and click left/right mouse button to switch range size
tooltip.origolds_ia.bs.kela: "Get some JinKela in the mix, one bag does a double fix!"
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.placer:
Hold a block and Alt+Middle-click to bind a block
After binding, Alt+Left-click to get a block blueprint
The blueprint can be placed anywhere within a 9x9x9 area centered on the Origold Placer
In blueprint mode, Alt+Right-click to exit and save the blueprint
After saving, the Origold Placer will periodically try to place the block at the blueprint position
Hold Ctrl and click left/right mouse button to switch the placement interval
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.redstone_puls:
Sends out a redstone signal periodically
You can decide how long the period is
tooltip.origolds_ia.bs.redstone_pulse_cl: "Why is this clock not running on either electricity or clockwork?"
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.hyperhopper:
A highly customizable hopper
Allows you to set the transfer interval and the quantity transferred per operation
Hold an item and press Alt+middle mouse button to bind that item; afterwards only it can enter
Press Alt+middle with an empty hand to clear the binding
Hold Ctrl and click Left/Right Mouse Button to rotate the input port along the current axis
Hold Ctrl+Alt and click Left/Right Mouse Button to rotate the input port along the vertical axis
Hold Ctrl+Shift and click Left/Right Mouse Button to rotate the output port along the current axis
Hold Ctrl+Shift+Alt and click Left/Right Mouse Button to rotate the output port along the vertical axis
tooltip.origolds_ia.bs.hyperhopper: "The ultimate evolution of the hopper is the Super Hopper; the ultimate evolution of the Super Hopper is the nothing hopper"
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.hyperfurnace:
A furnace that uses OGE as fuel to rapidly smelt items
Hold Ctrl and click Left/Right Mouse Button to toggle smelting speed tiers
Higher tiers consume additional OGE
tooltip.origolds_ia.bs.hyperfurnace: "It smelts faster than anything else, though it does guzzle power"
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.chrysopoeia_s:
Converts inserted ores into Alchemical Construct Value
Consumes OGE to produce 1 Gold Ingot for every 2,048u of Alchemical Construct Value accumulated
tooltip.origolds_ia.bs.chrysopoeia_stati: "Turning stone into gold... Expensive stones only!"
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.mech_crafter:
A crafter that uses OGE to rapidly craft items
Hold an item and click on the internal crafting grid slots to lock a recipe
The auto-crafter accepts only the items required by the recipe
Consumes OGE to craft the item once recipe conditions are met
tooltip.origolds_ia.bs.mech_crafter: "It never gets tired, and it never asks why you don't just craft it yourself"

tooltip.origolds_ia.rainbow_mark:
Can be applied to Fire or Magic OGE Generators, or various resource generators, to trigger Iridescent Overclock mode for rapid operation
Can be recharged with Magigold Cores
Hold the item and click Left/Right Mouse Button to toggle Iridescent Overclock tiers
Higher overclock multipliers result in increased production efficiency loss
tooltip.origolds_ia.rainbow_mark.bs: "The rainbow's glow is a lie told by light, yet a truth spoken by productivity"

tooltip.origolds_ia.volunteer_watcher:
An AFK dummy that acts as a simulated player or simulated mob target. Shift-Right Click to retrieve
Has two modes: Player Mode and Mob Target Mode. Shift-Left Click to switch
In Player Mode, it force-loads surrounding chunks, allowing mob spawning and other behaviors
In Mob Target Mode, it continuously attracts mob aggro, but does not load chunks
Can work with the Origold Sawblade Mount
tooltip.origolds_ia.ctrl.volunteer_watch:
Ctrl-Left Click to enter quick bind mode to select a nearby Origold Sawblade Slot (Right Click to exit)
Once bound, damage dealt by the slot's blade is considered dealt by this dummy, thus drawing aggro
Right-click the dummy to open a config screen where you can view, edit, sort, and unbind bound slots
Right-click the leftmost sort icon to enter preview mode (Right Click to exit)
Preview mode shows you where the Origold Sawblade Slot you just clicked is
tooltip.origolds_ia.bs.volunteer_watcher: "Don't feel guilty when using him; what these college students lack most is precious work experience"
tooltip.origolds_ia.circular_sawblade:
Can be installed on any face of the Origold Sawblade Mount
Can use iron blocks to replenish uses
Can also be used as an attacker in the Origold Sawblade Mount; it is very durable
You can also hold it and hit people without consuming durability... but it can't be enchanted, so will anyone actually do that?
tooltip.origolds_ia.circular_sawblade.bs: "...at least it certainly looks like it could saw something."
tooltip.origolds_ia.useful.sawblade_moun:
A base for circular sawblades. Requires a circular sawblade and an attacker to work
The attacker can be any melee weapon
Once a blade and attacker are installed, it will attempt to consume OGE to attack targets in the blade's block. Consumes the attacker's durability based on the number of attacks
Enchanted attackers will not break; when durability is low, they are placed into the waste slot in the bottom
Stores EXP from killed targets, but EXP is prioritized to repair an attacker enchanted with mending; you can take out the stored EXP
Logistics behavior differs from most containers
tooltip.origolds_ia.ctrl.sawblade_mount:
Can be interacted with by various hoppers (including the Origold Hyperhopper) and wireless logistics pipes
Hoppers can input any item that meets the attacker criteria; when outputting, only items in the waste slot are extracted
Wireless logistics pipes can input any item that meets the attacker criteria and EXP; when outputting, only the stored EXP is extracted
tooltip.origolds_ia.bs.sawblade_mount: "Solves the problem of Minecraft's stonecutter not biting"
message.origolds_ia.sawblade_none: No sawblade is mounted on that face
message.origolds_ia.sawblade_worn: This Circular Sawblade is worn out - recharge it in a crafting table with Iron Blocks
